text:
Irene: dropping a mini-map mock for the Rollouts timeline — goal: let people jump to a dense point quickly without losing keyboard context. Figma: https://figma.com/...

Samir: nice. Two quick problems I saw: (1) mini-map hover shows a floating scrubbing tooltip that blocks the mini-map when density is compact, (2) keyboard users can't jump the mini-map with arrow keys, only mouse.

Bea: Agree on keyboard. Proposal: allow focus to move into mini-map with Tab, then Left/Right to step 1% increments, Shift+Left/Right to step 5%, and Home/End to go to start/end. Announce each step via a single polite live region: e.g. "Timeline scrub: v6.2.0 \1 12%".

Connor: UX nit on the floating tooltip: it currently animates fade-in which makes SR announce delays and produces duplicate live events. Suggest remove animation for tooltips when reduce-motion is set and debounce mouse tooltip shows to 120ms. Also pin tooltip outside the mini-map bounds when it would overlap content.

a11y-bot: Automated check: found duplicate live region usage when both tooltip aria-label and a separate announcer update. Recommendation: use one aria-live region (role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"true\") for timeline positioning. For keyboard controls, expose aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow on the focusable scrubber element.

Irene: Good call. For the mini-map keyboard control we should use `role=\"slider\"` with aria-valuetext set to full context: "v6.2.0, 12% traffic, changelog: fix cache". That lets SR users understand position without a separate announcer. But need to be careful because `slider` implies continuous numeric control. Any objections?

Samir: I like `role=\"slider\"` for keyboard semantics, but we must ensure arrow keys change discrete steps (we control step size). aria-valuetext is the right place for descriptive text. Also add a small offscreen helper text: "Use Shift to jump larger steps" for discoverability.

Bea: For focus visuals at compact density the mini-map scrubbing thumb is tiny. Recommend 3px outline + 6px min-hit-area (visually 2px, but hit area 24px). CSS snippet:

`.mini-thumb { width: 6px; height: 16px; outline: 3px solid var(--focus); margin: -8px 0; } /* expands hit area */`

Connor: Copy question: we currently label the primary action "Promote to latest" in the drawer which reads oddly. Suggest shortening to "Promote" and adding `aria-describedby` pointing to a small text node: "Promote creates a new rollout serving selected version at 100%." This keeps button short but accessible.

a11y-bot: Contrast check: the mini-map active thumb color against dark background fails at compact sizes. Recommend using border or patterned fill for contrast or change thumb color to meet 3:1. Also ensure focus ring meets 3:1.

Irene: For rollback / safety-net flow — idea: if user uses keyboard to rollback, make the confirmation inline (not modal) so focus doesn't jump. Show an inline confirm row with a keyboard-focusable "Confirm rollback" + "Cancel" and an Undo toast after action. If the changelog has a flagged breaking change, escalate to modal. Thoughts?

Samir: Inline confirm is friendlier for keyboard flow. Make sure we add `aria-live=\"assertive\"` for rollback success message, and keep the Undo focusable. For flagged rollbacks we show modal with role=\"alertdialog\" and trap focus.

Bea: Accessibility microcopy: change tooltip short form from "v6.2.0" to "v6.2.0 \1 12% \1 Fix: token expiry". That reduces confusion when users arrow fast. Also include a short id for variants: "A (id: a1c2)" so SR doesn't read identical words.

Connor: One more: the mini-map shows a live sparkline of latency. For performance we throttle updates to 250ms and don't update SR on metric changes unless user scrubs. Prevents noisy announcements.

a11y-bot: Reminder: include axe-e2e tests for keyboard interactions, VoiceOver + TalkBack screenshots in PR, and a short regression checklist. Also record reduced-motion behavior for tooltip and thumb animations.

Irene: Great action items: Samir -> implement slider role + step behavior; Bea -> update Figma for focus + compact hit-area; Connor -> tooltip/no-animation + copy tweaks; I'll add rollback inline confirm UI to the spec. Target: patch release for keyboard + SR fixes, follow-up for tooltips + mini-map polish. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
